item.title: Log In and Enter Workspace
item.description: This section describes how to log in to the KubeSphere web console and enter a workspace. Prerequisites You need to obtain the username and password of a workspace member. You need to contact the KubeSphere platform administrator to obtain the IP address and port number of the web console. Depending on your network environment, you may need to configure firewall policies and traffic forwarding policies.
